verdict.rationale: GitLab explicitly documents its REST API using the OpenAPI 3.0 specification, states this is autogenerated from the API code and kept accurate, and provides the raw OpenAPI 3.0 spec file in the monorepo, plus an interactive browsable/testable API doc built on it. This directly satisfies the story of a downloadable, machine-readable API spec. Missing for 10: no independent/community confirmation of successfully consuming the downloaded spec file in practice.
